title: PURPOSE.yml v1 — optional operational manifest
description: The OPTIONAL manifest a project may commit at the repository root. Adoption of the Purpose Source License is one committed LICENSE file and is complete without this file (FS-00 §6.10 as amended 2026-08-31-B; D23). Nothing in this manifest is required for adoption, listing, claiming, allocation or certificates. When the file is absent — or wholly unparseable — the published defaults apply: weight class `standard`, steward-default allocation, no attribution overrides, no successor (FS-02 §6 FS02-050). The `license` and `licensor` blocks are INFORMATIONAL MIRRORS and are never authoritative: the committed LICENSE file is the only source of truth for adoption and for which licence version a repository carries (D13). A mismatch between `license.id` here and the detected LICENSE text is reported as `reg.manifest_license_mismatch` and changes no legal fact. Handling of an out-of-bounds value differs by section: non-attribution fields are rejected FIELD BY FIELD (the offending field is ignored, its default applies, and a rejection record is published in the repo record's `manifest.rejections` block — FS02-052), while ANY invalid field inside `attribution` fails that WHOLE section closed to defaults, never partially applied (FS-06 FS06-061). Bounds that JSON Schema cannot express — the sum of `attribution.manual_splits[].micro_shares` must be ≤ 200000 (20%), and each split target must resolve to a real GitHub account not on the exclusion list — are enforced by the platform parser (FS06-062). Parser limits: file ≤ 64 KiB, YAML safe-load, ≤ 1000 nodes (FS02-055).

schema.description: Manifest schema version. An UNKNOWN version means the whole manifest is ignored and defaults apply (`reg.manifest_schema_unsupported`, FS02-051) — it is never a hard failure for the repository.

license.description: Informational mirror of the committed LICENSE file. Non-authoritative (D13): the file in the repository decides adoption and version.

id.description: The licence identifier the project believes it carries. MUST equal the identifier detected in the LICENSE file, else `reg.manifest_license_mismatch` is recorded. The final registered identifier string is pending (URS §21 OPEN-20); `PurposeSource-1.0` is the working form.

url.description: Canonical licence-text URL. Informational; the byte-exact text at the steward's canonical endpoint governs.

licensor.description: Informational mirror of who licenses the work. Non-authoritative and legally inert: it grants nothing, assigns nothing, and no platform decision reads it. Contributors keep their copyright — no copyright assignment, ever.

display.description: Display metadata for the project's public registry page. Purely cosmetic: no gate, price, allocation, attribution or certificate reads it, and an invalid field here is a field-level rejection like any other non-attribution field. Absent values fall back to the GitHub display cache held in the repo record.

name.description: Preferred display name. The registry key stays the GitHub node_id (FS-00 §6.1).

summary.description: One-line project summary. Rendered verbatim; it is repository content, so the site escapes it and applies no claim-armour on the project's behalf.

contact.description: Public contact handle or URL. Do NOT put a personal email address here: this file is published as-is.

successor.description: Optional successor designation (D23). Recorded and displayed; legally inert until the succession process closes (URS §21 OPEN-29). An empty string means 'no designation'.

allocation.description: Category-fund defaults. Precedence: a dashboard-set project default wins over this manifest value, which wins over the steward default (FS02-054).

defaults.description: Slugs from the published category menu ONLY (`category-menu.v1.json` — the seven categories of the statutes' Art. 7; ENG-033). An unknown slug is rejected field-level with `reg.manifest_unknown_category` — free text can never enter the set.

attribution.description: The ONLY attribution override channels that exist (ENG-014). Schema owned by FS-06 §4 and imported verbatim by FS-02 §6. FAIL-CLOSED AS A WHOLE: any invalid or out-of-bounds field rejects this entire section and the verbatim Purpose-Points formula applies (FS06-061) — never a partial application.

exclude_paths.description: Globs whose files get weight 0. Cap 100 globs (FS-02 §6, adopted by FS-06).

exclude_users.description: GitHub logins removed from both halves of the computation. Cap 50 logins.

weights.description: Path re-classification ONLY. An admin may re-class a path, never invent a multiplier: the class enum fixes the values (code = 1.0, docs = 0.3, excluded = 0).

manual_splits.description: Micro-shares for non-git contributors (designers, off-repo documentation). Cap 10 entries; Σ micro_shares ≤ 200000 (20% of the repository) — the sum bound is enforced by the parser, not by this schema. Manual splits scale the computed shares down pro-rata to make room.

micro_shares.description: Micro-shares out of 1000000. Individually ≤ 200000, and ≤ 200000 in total across all entries.

ignore_revs_extra.description: Additional full commit SHAs merged into the `--ignore-revs-file` input alongside a repository's own .git-blame-ignore-revs (ENG-009).

categorySlug.description: A category slug (e.g. `environment`, `health`). A SHAPE, deliberately not the closed enum: this file is untrusted repository content whose unknown values are rejected field by field against the published menu at parse time (`reg.manifest_unknown_category`, FS02-052), and pinning the enum here would republish this contract every time the menu changed. The menu itself is `category-menu.v1.json`.

githubLogin.description: A GitHub login. Display-only everywhere in this contract set; identity is the node_id (FS-00 §6.1).

githubNodeId.description: An opaque GitHub GraphQL node_id. The primary key for repositories and people throughout this contract set (FS-00 §6.1).
